hook_text: Want a circle 8 cm across? If you open your compasses to 8 cm, it will be way too big.
clip_script: Mural day in East London! First the grid: lines cross at right angles, so squares and rectangles come out perfect. Count spaces, not dots. Now the compasses. The opening is the radius! For a circle 8 cm across, open to 4 cm. Point in, hold the top, turn. Now keep that opening and step it around the circle: one, two, three, four, five, six. A six-petal flower!
visual_style: A school wall becoming a mural, with a grid overlay and a giant compass drawing glowing circles and petals.
mood: Creative and calm, like an art class with a twist.
pacing: Quick grid shapes, a slow careful circle, then a satisfying flower reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw your own six-petal flower.
